createdAt.description: When it was created, in UTC. Absent if it was created before AICo recorded it: it then counts as existing since always.

formerIds.description: Ids it had before, oldest first, added by update-id. Threads keep the ids they were written with: a former id still designates it in messages written before the change.

id.patternErrorMessage: must be kebab-case: lowercase letters and digits separated by single hyphens

until.description: When it stopped having this id, in UTC.

title: AICo id history
description: When a position or an employee was created and the ids it had before, in history.json next to its config.json. Written by AICo, not by hand: absent for one created before AICo recorded it.
